elements_selected.content: At viewports ≤899px the widget is `display:none` via base.html:487-515, but the Sigma instantiation in themes/default/_graph.html:396 (or the mini-widget's init path) still runs on render tick and throws `Error: Sigma: Container has no width` — reviewer captured 23 instances. Guard instantiation/resize: check `container.offsetWidth > 0` before `new Sigma(...)`, and bail out of resize ticks when width is zero. Related to but narrower than widget-overlay; can ship independently.
